minutes.headline: Building committee interviewed Taylor and Burns for Town Hall and Ritter building design and rated the team favorably; no selection vote.
minutes.summary: The committee interviewed Taylor and Burns Architects and subconsultants BLW Engineers about historic renovation of the Town Hall and Ritter building. Topics were preservation standards, energy systems, contingency, community engagement and cost control. After the team left, members shared favorable impressions and rated reference checks, staffing and subconsultants. A short Monday meeting on space needs was planned, and the meeting adjourned.

budget_items.topic: Inflation Reduction Act grant for geothermal HVAC (Westford library example)
budget_items.what_was_said: BLW described a library project where a federal grant would have made geothermal cheaper, but the town could not float the cost until the grant arrived.
Taylor recommended carrying a robust contingency for unknowns in old buildings until bidding.

budget_items.topic: Prior renovation of the old school building
budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the earlier renovation estimate was far above what the committee expected, so cost estimating should happen throughout design.

budget_items.topic: Mass Save rebates and cost control
budget_items.what_was_said: BLW said local vendor relationships, lead times and Mass Save rebates help control equipment costs.
Taylor said escalation is slowing and estimates include contingency for it, using an independent cost estimator.

decisions.decision: Chair will post a 30-minute meeting for Monday to revisit space needs, and check other members' availability.
Chair to ask Taylor and Burns who their structural engineer is and their old wood-frame experience.
Next full meeting to be December 2nd.

what_happened.line: The Municipal Building Design Committee interviewed Taylor and Burns Architects and subconsultants BLW Engineers for the Town Hall and Ritter building design.
No selection vote was taken; after the team left, members shared favorable impressions and rated reference checks, staffing and subconsultants.
The team was asked about construction contingency, cost control, bidding climate and Mass Save rebates, and the chair raised an earlier renovation estimate that ran well above expectations.
The chair will ask the firm who its structural engineer is and about its old wood-frame experience, and will post a 30-minute Monday meeting on space needs.
The next full meeting was set for December 2nd, and the meeting adjourned by roll call.

why_it_matters: This is the step that picks who designs the renovation of Town Hall and the Ritter building, and the design and contingency choices made now shape the cost residents may later be asked to vote on.
watch_next: Monday's 30-minute space needs meeting, which the chair is to post.
The next full meeting on December 2nd, where a selection decision may follow.
